description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'GrainMethodInvoker' which is responsible for invoking a request on a grain within the Orleans framework. It manages the invocation pipeline, including interceptors, execution of the request, and response handling.

classes.name: GrainMethodInvoker
classes.description: A class that manages invocation of methods on grains, including interceptors and response processing within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the invocation pipeline, processing interceptors and executing the request, handling exceptions and managing the response.

methods.name: GetMethodEntry
methods.description: Retrieves method information for the invoked method, handling generic methods and using the implementation map.
